config.script:
ai = self.view.custom.asset.assetInfo
	si = {'modeName': 'Idle', 'workOrderId': None, 'itemId': None}	
	modeCode = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('modeCode', system.kanoa.asset.getAssetModes({'assetId': ai['assetId'], 'modeName': si['modeName']}))		
	modeSourceId = system.kanoa.asset.getModeSourceId('Schedule')		
	
	#End the scheduled event the asset is running, if any, so the schedule doesn't start it again (it takes over at its next event). Ending an operator's own mode hands the asset back to the schedule.
	system.kanoa.schedule.endScheduledEvent(ai['assetId'], self.view.custom.security.userId)
	#The Idle change leaves the asset with no scheduled event, which clears Line/OEE/scheduleBlockId
	
	assetOperationInfo = {'assetId': ai['assetId'], 'modeCode': modeCode, 'workOrderId': si['workOrderId'], 'itemId': si['itemId'], 'standardRate': None, 'modeSourceId': modeSourceId, 'tStamp': system.date.now(), 'includeChildren': True, 'checkAssetSchedule': True}
	modeEventId, msg = system.kanoa.event.assetOperationChange(assetOperationInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	if msg or modeEventId is None: system.kanoa.toast.dismiss({'id': 'runControl'}); system.kanoa.toast.show({'id': 'runControl', 'type': 'warning', 'message': 'Could not change asset mode. %s'%msg})
	else:
		try: ended = self.view.custom.asset.tagInfo['modeName'] or 'The run'
		except: ended = 'The run'
		system.kanoa.toast.dismiss({'id': 'runControl'}); system.kanoa.toast.show({'id': 'runControl', 'type': 'info', 'message': '%s ended. Checking the schedule for what runs next.' % ended})
	
	return

config.script:
#The user selection is stored in session custom properties
	#If scheduleId is not None, we will get wo/pc info from the scheduled event
	#Else if woId is not None, we'll get wo and pc from the wo
	#Else we will just do a product run 
	
	system.perspective.print('start button pressed')

	itemSelection = self.view.custom.itemSelection
	assetId = self.view.custom.asset.assetInfo.assetId
	runTypeSelector = self.view.custom.selectedTab
		
	if runTypeSelector == 'Product':
		workOrderId = None
		itemId = itemSelection['itemId']
		modeName = 'Production'
		scheduleBlockId = None
	elif runTypeSelector == 'Orders': 
		if itemSelection['workOrderId'] is None: return
		workOrderId = itemSelection['workOrderId']
		itemId = itemSelection['itemId']
		modeName = 'Production'
		scheduleBlockId = None
	elif runTypeSelector == 'Schedule':	
		if itemSelection['scheduleId'] is None: return
		scheduleInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.schedule.getScheduleBlocks({'scheduleBlockId': itemSelection['scheduleId']}),0)
		workOrderId = scheduleInfo['workOrderId']
		itemId = scheduleInfo['itemId']
		modeName = scheduleInfo['modeName']
		scheduleBlockId = itemSelection['scheduleId']	#Recorded on the run's mode event by assetOperationChange
	else:
		system.perspective.print('unknown runTypeSelector')
		return

	#Checks the item's required tooling first, and may ask the operator to confirm (root startRun)
	self.view.rootContainer.startRun({'assetId': assetId, 'workOrderId': workOrderId, 'itemId': itemId, 'modeName': modeName,
		'scheduleBlockId': scheduleBlockId, 'runTypeSelector': runTypeSelector}, False)

	return

customMethods.name: startRun
customMethods.script:
'''
		Starts the run the operator picked. Unless toolingChecked, a run of an item first checks the item's required tooling on
		the machine: anything not mounted opens a confirm, and its OK (runStartToolingConfirm) starts it with toolingChecked.
		start (dict): assetId, workOrderId, itemId, modeName, scheduleBlockId, runTypeSelector
	'''
	assetId = start['assetId']
	workOrderId = start['workOrderId']
	itemId = start['itemId']
	modeName = start['modeName']
	scheduleBlockId = start['scheduleBlockId']

	if not toolingChecked and itemId is not None:
		missing = system.kanoa.tooling.checkRequiredTooling({'assetId': assetId, 'itemId': itemId})
		if hasattr(missing, 'getRowCount') and missing.getRowCount() > 0:
			text = '. '.join(missing.getValueAt(r, 'message') for r in range(missing.getRowCount())) + '. Start anyway?'
			system.perspective.openPopup('runStartToolingConfirm', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm',
				{'text': text, 'messageHandler': 'runStartToolingConfirm', 'inputPayload': dict(start)}, title='Required tooling', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
			return

	modeSourceId = system.kanoa.asset.getModeSourceId('Operator')
	modeCode = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('modeCode', system.kanoa.asset.getAssetModes({'assetId': assetId, 'modeName': modeName}))
	
	if self.view.custom.asset.customAttributes.has_key('_runSetupViewPath') and self.view.custom.asset.customAttributes['_runSetupViewPath'] is not None:
		data = {"assetId": assetId, "modeCode": modeCode, "workOrderId": workOrderId, "itemId": itemId, "modeSourceId": modeSourceId, "userId": self.view.custom.security.userId, "scheduleBlockId": scheduleBlockId}
		system.perspective.openPopup('Confirm Start', self.view.custom.asset.customAttributes['_runSetupViewPath'], {'value': data})
		#The asset's own run setup takes over: Run Control's popup (opened from the info panel) closes
		system.perspective.closePopup('runControl')
	else:
		standardRate = None
		assetOperationInfo = {'assetId': assetId, 'modeCode': modeCode, 'workOrderId': workOrderId, 'itemId': itemId, 'standardRate': standardRate, 'modeSourceId': modeSourceId, 'tStamp': system.date.now(), 'includeChildren': True, 'scheduleBlockId': scheduleBlockId}
		modeEventId, msg = system.kanoa.event.assetOperationChange(assetOperationInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		if msg: system.kanoa.toast.dismiss({'id': 'runControl'}); system.kanoa.toast.show({'id': 'runControl', 'type': 'warning', 'message': 'Could not change asset mode. %s'%msg})
		else:
			system.kanoa.toast.dismiss({'id': 'runControl'}); system.kanoa.toast.show({'id': 'runControl', 'type': 'success', 'message': 'Asset has been set to %s'%modeName})
			#Started: close Run Control when it's the popup the info panel opens (embedded on a dashboard there's no such popup)
			system.perspective.closePopup('runControl')

	if start['runTypeSelector'] == 'Schedule': system.perspective.sendMessage('itemSelection', {'workOrderId': None, 'itemId': None, 'scheduleId': None})	#clear selection

	return
